Welcome to the Iron Range Retreat!

Here is everything you need for your stay with us, from planning your time prior to departure to the Giant's Ridge area, all the way through checkout. In this easy-to-navigate link, you will find information about the cabin, ideas of things to do in the area, our Wi-Fi login credentials, and so much more.

In order to best enjoy your time in our home, we encourage you to add this "app" to your phone. All of the content will even be accessible when your phone is offline.

* It's not really an "app", but more a tool for easy access on your home screen

  • For iPhone:
    • Tap the square with arrow pointing up at the bottom of your screen
    • Select "Add to Home Screen"
  • For Android:
    • Tap "Add to Home Screen" where prompted when first accessing the site

Print or Save a PDF
If you would like to print certain pages ahead of traveling, or if you'd like to save a PDF to your device, just tap the print button above. It won't print right away, but will create a PDF which you can save or print.

Contacting Us
We pride ourselves on swiftly meeting guest needs. We can be reached as follows:

  • Preferred: Airbnb or VRBO message
  • Phone: 404-358-1552 (emergencies)
  • Instagram: @Bk_stays
  • Facebook: BK Stays

What Next?
Please relax, unwind, have fun, and enjoy your stay!

We sincerely love Northern Minnesota, the Iron Range, and Giant's Ridge, and are excited to share them all with you! The rolling hills and stunning fall colors make this area feel like a postcard come to life. Summers are all about fun in the sun—swimming, fishing, boating, and every kind of water activity you can think of. We’re lucky to be close to the cozy little ski resort for winter adventures and surrounded by some great golf courses for those who love to hit the greens. You've chosen the perfect spot to enjoy the best of every season, and we can’t wait for you to experience it too.

Welcome to The Iron Range Retreat!

This MASSIVE 6,000 sqft home has 6 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, sleeps 20 guests, and is LOADED with amenities! It is centrally located near Giants Ridge Ski Resort, The Quarry & Legend Golf Courses, and has public boat and lake access in Voyageurs Retreat. Enjoy a barrel sauna, jacuzzi, game room, outdoor playground, firepit, both lake and ski slope views. This is the Ultimate Minnesota Escape Up North for large groups of Family and Friends All Year Long!

"

We could post turn-by-turn directions here.

OR - you could just use Waze or Google Maps.

Either option will get you to the home ;)

Address: 5935 Voyageurs Trail, Biwabik, MN 55708

The Access Code for the front door is

1552✔

To lock the door, simply press the lock button. Please make sure all external doors are locked whenever you leave.

* If for some reason the code doesn't work please call me at 404-358-1552. I will get you the lockbox code for the spare key!

Standard check-out is at 10:00 AM on your departure date (Unless you've paid for a late check-out).

When you've finished your stay, technically, you can just leave no questions asked lol :) But, if you really wanted to give our cleaning team some love, we would appreciate it if you would take care of a few simple things:

  • Dishwasher - Load and start the dishwasher
  • Grill - Please Properly Clean If Used
  • Jacuzzi - Close and latch the lid
  • Sauna - Close the door.
  • Towels - Place all used towels in the shower.
  • Trash Is Critical! Please Review Our Trash Section Here!
  • Lock Up - Lock all doors

We hope you guys had an amazing stay! Thank you again and safe travels back home.

There is free Wi-Fi for your use. The details are:

WIFI Name: Iron Range Reteat

WIFI Password: IronRangeRetreat

The service is provided for your enjoyment but you are responsible for safe and appropriate use and complying with all laws. If there is any loss of service please contact us.

Please Watch and Read Before Use!

The LEFT dial is the temperature - Min to Max etc. Leave the dial just slightly under MAX- don't crank it to full MAX.

The RIGHT dial is the timer. Each number is for 1 hour, 2 hours, 3 hours, 4 hours etc.

Do Not Turn past 1 hour (straight to 2, or 3 or more) or the heater WILL NOT start until 2/3 hours).

Simply turn the dial to ONE (1) and the heater will run on MAX for ONE (1) Hour.

Put the Left Dial Just Under Max, and Select 1 Hour on the Right Dial.

Keep it Simple :)

There is a propane grill for your personal use on the back patio. Please follow the grill instructions carefully when using propane. Do not forget to close the valve when you're done!

We always try to keep a full tank on site - but sometimes they run out before before we can get a replacement there. If you run out and need a replacement, we can try and get you a replacement delivered - but - depending on timing - it may be faster for you to run and exchange the empty.

Of course we will reimburse you for the tank and your time!

The fireplace button is on the wall to the right and it operates similarly to a "thermostat" - Gently slide the dial to the right to increase the heat/flame size, and back to the left to lower it, or turn it OFF. The pilot light should already bit lit upon your arrival, so you shouldn't need to touch anything on the actual fireplace itself.

Please Watch the Jacuzzi Video Below for Directions

Shower Before Entering

No Lotions, Soaps, Oils, Bubble Products (they cause damage)

If a Foreign Substance is Found, a Damage Fee Will Be Assessed

Do Not Add Any Outside Chemicals to the Spa

No Glass In/Around the Jacuzzi (Plastic Only)

Children Under 16 Require Adult Supervision At All Times

Pregnant Individuals Should Consult a Physician Before Use

Always Cover the Jacuzzi When Not in Use

Unclip All Four Safety Clips Before Opening the Lid

Connect All Four Safety Clips When Covering

Turn Off All Jets When Not in Use

Do Not Press the “Menu” Button

Use Only Temp Up, Down, Jets 1/2, and Light

This house is packed with indoor fun, including Pool, Ping Pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, Air Hockey, Darts, and a full set of poker chips with a playing table. If anything is missing or broken, PLEASE LET US KNOW IMMEDIATELY so we can order any replacements.

There should be a set of all-weather cornhole boards somewhere on the patio. If you notice anything is broken or missing, please let us know right away so we can order replacements. It would be very helpful if you would return them to a covered area after each day so they don't wander off or get ruined in the weather :)

Children 12 and under!

Probably our favorite playground in the area. No need to leave the home for the kids to burn off some energy! It’s a safe and fun space for endless playtime. Please ensure an adult is always present and never leave children unattended.

Never Add Any Foreign Substance To The Jacuzzi (No Bubbles or Soaps)!

Always Put The Cover Back On When Not In Use!

Do Not Raise The Temp Above 102*F

The jacuzzi is thoroughly inspected after each guest. Failure to adhere will cause additional maintenance and cleaning measures, or worse, damage to the unit. Fines will be imposed if evidence of foreign substance or damage is found during inspection. 

Please refer to the “Hot Tub/Jacuzzi” section in the guide for full details and usage instructions.
"

There are many sleeping options and plenty of square footage. But - we still want to try not to overcrowd our home. The maximum guest limit is 20 persons (age 2+) unless otherwise approved. Please reach out prior to arrival if you have any additional capacity requests. Any unapproved guest overcapacity will be charged an additional fee.

Commercial vehicles, buses and inoperative or unlicensed vehicles or recreational equipment of any type may not be kept, parked or stored anywhere on the Property except within a Dwelling’s garage.

No operable passenger vehicles, lawn tractors, trailers, motorcycles, golf carts, snowmobiles, watercraft or other recreational equipment may be parked, kept or stored on the Property (i) within 30 feet from the right of way of the common roadway or within 10 feet from the property line of any Unit, or (ii) for more than fourteen (14) consecutive days, unless parked, kept or stored within a garage or otherwise screened in a manner such that the items are not visible from another Unit, any community association common element, the lake, or the common roadway. Such vehicle/equipment shall be kept and maintained in a clean and orderly condition.

Parking and storage upon the streets serving the Property is prohibited except in those areas designated by appropriate signage as permitting parking.
Please check the "Trash" section in the guide for full instructions on where and how to dispose of your garbage.

Please Remove All Trash Each Night or at Checkout

HOA Dumpsters are located 1.7 miles North on Voyager’s Trail - 

Directly Across From Sunset Road (map below)

All trash must be Bagged and Secured/Tied before placing it in the HOA dumpsters.

No Loose Trash Allowed In Dumpsters Cans

3 Trash Cans in Garage For Temporary Storage Only.

There are (3) Ecobee Thermostats on the wall. The first (1st) is on the main level in the Great Room / Hallway, the second (2nd) is upstairs in Bedroom 4, and the third (3rd) is downstairs on the wall near the stairs in the game room. 

If you're running the air conditioning or heating - PLEASE keep all windows and outside doors closed to ensure they operate at maximum efficiency. We recommend a setting of about 72*F which we find keeps the place at a comfortable temperature.

Location

Our home is located on the southernmost point of Wynne Lake within the HOA.

Biking Trails

Look for green dashed lines on the HOA map(s) — these indicate 8–10 ft wide aggregate bike paths that run along the entire east side of the HOA. These trails connect directly to the Mesabi Trail farther north (where the line turns solid red on the map).

Hiking Trails

Marked with orange dashed lines on the map. These tTrails begin right near our home, continuing north alongside both lakes and extending all the way to Sabin Lake near the Embarrass River.

Parks, Picnic Areas & Lake Access

Located along the east sides of Wynne Lake and Sabin Lake, you’ll find numerous HOA access points for:

Picnic areas, Benches, Canoe/kayak launches, Swimming spots, Day-use docks - etc.

Refer to your map for icons identifying each amenity.

Recommended Swimming Area

We recommend guests visit Red Pine Beach Park, located about 1 mile up the road.

Boat Access

Wynne Lake Boat Launch

- located on the northwest side of Wynne Lake, near Giants Ridge ski area.

Sabin Lake Boat Launch

  • located on the west side of Sabin Lake, near The Legend Golf Course.

Note: Wynne Lake and Sabin Lake are not navigable between each other by motorboat.
